reason: Provides LAN access to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI through a reverse proxy, with an in-app directory picker and UUID polyfill; the README explicitly states that the unauthenticated control plane exposes remote code execution to reachable LAN clients, requiring human security review.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供局域网反向代理、应用内工作区目录选择器和 UUID 兼容补丁，但控制面板无认证，仅应在可信局域网中使用。
summaries.en: Provides LAN reverse proxy access to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with an in-app workspace directory picker and UUID compatibility polyfill, but the unauthenticated control plane should only be used on trusted LANs.

capabilities: Opens an HTTP listener on a LAN-facing address
Reverse-proxies the unauthenticated web control plane and WebSocket traffic
Rewrites Host and Origin headers for LAN clients
Provides an in-app directory browser for workspace selection
Injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill into web pages
